theorem_title: Direct primorial-sieve transfer for the eta0 exponential sum
formal_statement:
namespace TaoFivePrimes

theorem eta0_primorial_sieve_transfer
    (x : ℕ) (h1 : 87 * 10 ^ 35 ≤ x) (theta : ℝ) :
    let y : ℝ := (x : ℝ) / 1000
    ‖smoothedExpSum eta0 (primorial (Nat.sqrt (x / 1000))) y theta -
        smoothedExpSum eta0 1 y theta‖ ≤
      (9 : ℝ) / 10 ^ 8 * y := by sorry

end TaoFivePrimes
natural_language_statement: Let $x\ge 8.7\times 10^{36}$ and put $y=x/1000$. For the logarithmic cutoff $\eta_0$, changing the smoothed von Mangoldt sum from modulus $1$ to the primorial of $\lfloor\sqrt{x/1000}\rfloor$ changes its value by at most $9\times 10^{-8}y$, uniformly in the real frequency. This is the specialized sieve-modulus transfer used after Proposition 7.2.
